title: ～なあ — sentence-final feeling
summary: A sentence-final particle that lets feelings out: admiration, a sigh or a wish. It is often used like a monologue and is casual.

body.p: Use it when moved by what is in front of you or musing to yourself: いい天気だなあ.
In 〜たいなあ or 〜ないかなあ it expresses a wish (早く帰りたいなあ).
ね asks the listener to agree. なあ is about your own feeling and needs no listener.

examples.ja: いい天気（てんき）だなあ。
この料理（りょうり）はおいしいなあ。
早（はや）く家（いえ）に帰（かえ）りたいなあ。
examples.tr: I really want to go home soon.

pitfalls: It is casual and unsuited to polite talk with superiors.
After a noun or な-adjective, だ appears (いい天気だなあ).
